title: CI: add non-blocking perf-smoke microbench job + structured artifacts for perf-canary
author: Sahana Iyer
description:
Context: As part of the Q1 2026 perf baseline + representative workload suite effort, we want a small set of microbenchmarks to run on every runtime PR to catch obvious regressions early. This PR adds a new CI job ("perf-smoke") that executes a curated subset of microbenchmarks and uploads a structured artifact that perf-canary can ingest.

Key points:
- Non-blocking (warn-only): the job runs on PRs but does not fail the overall workflow (continue-on-error). We still surface results in the job summary and as an artifact.
- Structured output: emits perf_smoke_report.json and perf_smoke_metadata.json with commit SHA, runner env, GPU/driver/CUDA versions, and per-test metrics (p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, and basic sanity counters). Schema is intended to match perf-canary’s ingestion expectations.
- Scope: keeps runtime impact low by running ~6 short microbenches (prefill, decode, kv-cache hit/miss, small-batch scheduler path) with fixed seeds and pinned configs.
- Safety: hard-pins benchmark seeds/configs and stamps build metadata to reduce "noise" diffs across runs. This does not attempt to be a baseline-quality run; it is strictly a smoke signal.

What this enables:
- perf-canary can start collecting PR-level perf smoke artifacts to build a history and eventually power gating (per ENG-4828 rollout plan: warn-only → soft fail → hard fail).

Out of scope:
- Any blocking policy, thresholds, or regression classification logic (handled in perf-canary + policy doc).
- Full representative workload suite execution (nightly/weekly pipelines).

Testing:
- Verified locally via tools/perf/perf_smoke_runner.py --dry-run and on CI with a forced rerun.
- Confirmed artifacts upload and schema validation step passes.

Rollout plan:
- Merge as warn-only for at least 2 weeks while we gather variance data.
- If CI runtime is acceptable and noise is understood, we’ll add summary diff posting in perf-canary and propose soft-fail criteria.

perf(smoke): add curated microbench list + config pinning
perf(smoke): add JSON schema + validator for report/metadata
runtime(build): stamp build/env metadata into perf output
docs(ci): add guidance for interpreting perf-smoke job
notable_diff_snippets: Workflow excerpt: name: perf-smoke; on: pull_request; jobs.perf-smoke.continue-on-error: true; steps include build runtime, run tools/perf/perf_smoke_runner.py, validate artifacts, upload-artifact (name: perf-smoke-${{ github.sha }}).
checks_summary: All checks passed. New check added: perf-smoke (non-blocking) — completed successfully; artifact uploaded (perf_smoke_report.json, perf_smoke_metadata.json).
review_conversation: Connor O'Brien (Release Eng): Can we ensure this doesn't become an implicit gate? I'd like the check to be clearly labeled warn-only and not required for merge in branch protection.

Sahana Iyer (author): Yep. The workflow uses continue-on-error and the check name is "perf-smoke (non-blocking)". Also confirmed with repo settings: not required. Added a note to docs/ci/perf-smoke.md.
Sean Gallagher (SRE): Please add environment stamping (driver/CUDA, instance type) to metadata; otherwise perf-canary can't separate drift from regression.
Sahana Iyer (author): Added perf_smoke_metadata.json with driver/CUDA/GPU/hostname + git SHA + build id. Also added a schema validator step so we don't silently break ingestion.
Hiro Tanaka (Kernel): The microbench list includes kv-cache miss/hit; can we pin seeds and sequence lengths so kernels team can reproduce locally?
Sahana Iyer (author): Pinned configs under tools/perf/configs/perf_smoke and fixed seeds in the runner. The runner prints the resolved config paths in the job logs.
Kira Volkov (Perf tooling): Please keep metrics minimal (p50/p95 + tokens/s) for now; don't add high-cardinality dimensions. Also ensure failures still produce artifacts when possible.

Sahana Iyer (author): Kept metrics minimal and added best-effort artifact write on partial failures; validation step is tolerant if a test is marked status=failed but still emits metadata + error string.
release_notes: Internal only: Added a non-blocking perf-smoke CI job that runs a small set of runtime microbenchmarks on PRs and uploads structured artifacts for perf-canary ingestion (warn-only; no gating).
